result:
Ever since I was young, I have always been enamoured by stories. The intricate details, the eloquently developed characters, and the scenes full of vivid imagery had a way of transporting me to a world full of boundless possibilities. However, what always fascinated me the most were stories of time travel. There's something about the concept of manipulating time, a phenomena we virtually have no control over, that's intriguing.

We follow a monotonic treadmill of time, constantly marching forward without any chance of looking back or skipping ahead. Time travel poses the question, what if we weren't bound by this unidirectional time flow? What if we could revisit the treasured past or take a sneak peek into the deterministic future? For me, time travel stories are more than just their sci-fi appeal. They're about possibilities, about second chances and a chance to remodel our past or future to our liking.

To be able to correct the wrongs in our past, or prevent mistakes yet to be made sound appealing, but it also reckons the age-old philosophy, ‘what’s meant to happen will find its way.' It poses questions and doubts about predetermined fate and destiny. It emphasizes the value of our present moment as it is the only absolute reality we know.

I often find myself fantasizing time traveling, not to change anything, but to empathize with my past self and reassure my future self. At the end of the day, these stories remind me, that time is precious and our present actions will script our past and shape our future.
